INSIGHT: If users can already search Vinted by image, our text cascade isn't the differentiator. The value is outfit decomposition. Future value prop: a curated library of outfits (men's, women's, seasonal) where each outfit is pre-identified and pre-decomposed. Users browse outfits, click any item, get Vinted listings instantly.
STATUS: Idea captured, not built. Ned confirmed 'that could be a cool value prop and worth building' — deprioritized until core image search pipeline is working.
IMPLEMENTATION WHEN READY: Content layer on top of existing infrastructure. Each curated outfit runs through the same Gemini + Playwright pipeline on import. Admin uploads outfit → items auto-identified + Playwright UUIDs cached → outfit goes live.
PRIORITY: After VPS deployment.
